description: This file implements a function to remove comments from a JavaScript source string, including handling of single-line ('//') and multi-line ('/* */') comments, with optional whitespace preservation.

methods.name: stripWithoutWhitespace
methods.description: Returns an empty string, used when whitespace removal is disabled.

methods.name: stripWithWhitespace
methods.description: Replaces non-whitespace characters in a substring with spaces, used to preserve formatting when removing comments.
